checks.details: POSIX sh syntax check; the headless-detection case pattern was also dry-run against a synthetic --headless --script argument list and correctly selected the unchanged direct-exec path.

checks.command: ./godotw (plain interactive launch), observed with `osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true'` and `top -pid <pid>`
checks.details: Before this change, exec'ing the Godot binary directly left the terminal/Claude frontmost and the game window occluded, with `sample` showing the main thread parked in -[CAMetalLayer nextDrawable] for the bulk of each frame. After routing the plain launch through `open -n -W -a <bundle> --args --path ... `, the frontmost process switched to Godot immediately and CPU usage sat around 35% actively rendering; `sample` no longer showed the main thread blocked in nextDrawable. Verified twice (direct `open -n -W -a` invocation, then through the edited ./godotw itself) and cleanly terminated both test instances afterward.

outstanding_acceptance: Fable 5.1 (Mac agent thread) to use the updated ./godotw for a real gameplay FPS probe and confirm measured frame times are usable evidence, not just window-focus/CPU sanity.
